function.name: addition
function.description: Adds multiple numbers and returns the sum.

numbers.description: Array of numbers to add together.

function.name: subtraction
function.description: Subtracts multiple numbers from the first number and returns the result.

first.description: The starting number from which other numbers will be subtracted.

subtract.description: Array of numbers to subtract from the first number.

function.name: multiplication
function.description: Multiplies multiple numbers and returns the product.

numbers.description: Array of numbers to multiply together.

function.name: square_root
function.description: Calculates the square root of a given number.

num.description: The number for which the square root will be calculated.
